research_contract.question: How should source, data and runtimes be placed across available hosts so useful work stays discoverable and recoverable within real resource limits?
source_scopes: Public runtime and project portability contracts
Redacted, owner-approved capacity, placement and restore receipts
research_contract.decision_to_change: Choose execution and data placement from verified host capability, ownership, connectivity and recovery evidence.
success_criteria: Trace one source revision to its authorized runtime and durable output without exposing private infrastructure.
Verify the required capacity, access and recovery path on the actual intended host.
falsifiers: The chosen host cannot demonstrate the required resource or recovery capability.
Placement makes source or outputs undiscoverable, crosses a data boundary or adds more recovery burden than it removes.
evidence_gaps: A historical readiness report does not establish current capacity or permission to move or restart a workload.
watch_triggers: New owner-approved outcome or counterexample changes the decision evidence.
The relevant source, operating constraint or acceptance boundary materially changes.
research_contract.answer_shape: A source-to-runtime placement receipt with resource constraints, restoration proof, remaining gaps and the owning operator.
research_contract.refresh_policy: Review when relevant owner evidence or decision conditions change; registration starts no collector, benchmark, scheduler or new execution lane.
